reason: A Windows-only dsh plugin that wraps the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with desktop shortcuts, browser/PWA launching, system-tray controls, local readiness detection, and task notifications.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 Windows 的 dsh 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供桌面快捷方式、浏览器应用窗口、系统托盘控制和任务通知。
summaries.en: A Windows dsh plugin that adds desktop shortcuts, browser app launching, system-tray controls, and task notifications to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: Creates and updates Windows desktop shortcuts and launcher files
Starts and stops the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI and browser application processes
Provides a Windows system tray interface and native notifications
Uses local HTTP readiness checks and browser/PWA discovery
